task_description: Build a university student grade-tracking web application with React + Tailwind frontend (pastel pink/purple palette, dark/light mode, i18n EN/ES), Node.js/Express backend with JWT authentication, and PostgreSQL database. Supports simple and composite subjects with configurable weight percentages for calculating weighted averages. Deployable on Vercel.

verification.summary: Full monorepo build succeeds. All 23 tests pass (18 backend + 5 frontend). Two review passes completed with all critical issues fixed: JWT fail-fast at module level, weight unit mismatch resolved (integers 1-100), PrismaClient singleton, Vercel serverless function with correct import path, rate limiting on auth, period endpoint optimized. Docker build skipped (Vercel deployment target).
